newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 29.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 29.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Budapest police chief Janos Bodracska said at a press conference he was hopeful the police would soon catch those who committed recent bombings and shhotings.
- The government will not interfere in the country's economic processes, delegates heard at an economic conference which stated that next year's inflation will be 18-22 percent.
- There will be no changes in electoral rules for the 1998 elections as there is no time to amend current laws.
- Representatives of minority organisations from 15 West European countries meeting in Budapest stated that Hungary's minority laws are exemplary.
